hypothesis: Exploit multiple thresholds on each shared convolution response to reduce exact phase-averaging cost without changing the statistical target.
interpolation: Same periodic piecewise-linear response and strict > threshold semantics as prior EI.
algorithm: Segment-uniform mixture survival plus atoms for flat segments; compensated event sweep sorted by response values. Bias orders precomputed once per fitted transform. Hybrid uses direct evaluation if B<8, cached endpoints if 8<=B<L, and sweep if B>=L.
design_status: Development used only Fish training inputs and synthetic numerical checks. All original datasets previously inspected. This is an implementation/complexity contribution, not an unseen-data accuracy confirmation.
baselines: independent sorted phase-sample K32 with floating-point tie guard
fairness: Strengthened finite-K code shares endpoints and specializes fixed K. Training-only backend profiling considers original/cached/sorted K32. All matched methods share data/budgets/threads.

numerical.groundtruth: original direct EI plus high-precision synthetic references
numerical.workflow: Refit thresholds/scaler/alpha inside each original inner fold, compare selected alpha and all test predictions with prior formal outputs. Full train/test feature differences and finite-K equality audited on representative full-data passes.

timing.exclude: compilation, input reads, one-time parameter preparation; those preparation costs reported separately
timing.interpretation: Local measured implementation performance, no hardware-independent acceleration guarantee
